title: Located partially within Subarea D and partially within C6-3A Districts
previewText: For a zoning lot fronting on West 23rd Street and Eleventh Avenue, located partially within Subarea D and partially within a C6-3A District, floor area may be transferred from the portion of the zoning lot in the C6-3A District to the portion in Subarea D.
